name: auth-05
title: Passkey 与多因素验证
description: 登录第二步：通行密钥、验证器 App、短信验证码和恢复码四种验证方式，可互相切换，并支持记住设备。

files.content:

  successAnnounce: "验证成功，身份验证已完成",

type Auth05Labels = typeof DEFAULT_LABELS

function formatLabel(
  template: string,
  values: Record<string, string | number>,
) {
  return template.replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (_, key: string) =>
    String(values[key] ?? ""),
  )
}

export { DEFAULT_LABELS, formatLabel }
export type { Auth05Labels }
